description: Department of Co-operative Development (NWP) - Amendment to the Gaz. Ex. No. 1981/2 of 22.08.2016, Regulations for Electing Committee members of regions at Multipurpose Co-operative Societies in NWP
reasoning: This gazette notification specifically deals with amendments to electoral regulations for co-operative societies in the North-Western Province. It focuses on election procedures, nomination processes, candidate qualifications, and electoral administration - all of which fall under the Elections category (Type 7) as it concerns electoral processes and related regulatory matters for cooperative society elections.
